commands.command: TBD: mine a fresh matched-current-response ambiguity corpus with source-diversity constraints before repeating history/outcome/boundary gates
commands.name: m118_fresh_source_diverse_matched_current_corpus

decision_rule: Proceed to another wrong-history outcome/boundary gate only if the fresh matched-current-response corpus contains enough distinct physical source pairs and decision steps before relocation.
failure_criteria: matched-current-response pairs remain concentrated in the same few seed/step pairs
future-envelope ambiguity exists only in rows that do not produce action-level history sensitivity
source-diverse pairs cannot be reconstructed through the M112/M113 replay path
hypothesis: M117 shows the current M113/M115 surface is exhausted. A fresh source-diverse matched-current-response corpus is needed before more boundary relocation or objective training.
success_criteria: fresh matched pairs cover substantially more physical source seed/step pairs than M111/M113
the result decides whether to repeat M113/M115 on the fresh corpus
